task.description: Review the diff for REQ-001a (git diff master...HEAD on branch feature/WF02-REQ-001a) per WF-02 Step 2b. FRONTEND-DEV reported 4 deliberate deviations from the design in its handoff (handoffs/WF02-REQ-001a/step-02-frontend-dev.json result section) — read that handoff's full result to see them, and judge each on its merits rather than treating any deviation as automatically disqualifying: (1) proxy.ts placed at src/proxy.ts instead of repo root, because Next resolves the middleware/proxy file relative to the app directory's parent, not true repo root — verify this claim yourself if you can, or treat it as a plausible engineering fact worth spot-checking rather than blocking on; (2) NextIntlClientProvider added around {children} in the locale layout, not in the original design's file tree, needed because LocaleSwitcher is a Client Component using useLocale/usePathname which throw without it; (3) 'checked in both light/dark theme' was reported as not applicable because globals.css has no data-theme split at all (single fixed dark palette) — verify this is true by reading globals.css yourself, don't take it on faith; (4) mobile/desktop viewport was checked only statically (no media query on .lang in globals.css) rather than visually, because no browser tool was available to the implementing agent — you have the same tool constraints, so assess whether this is an acceptable verification gap for this step or something that must block. Also run the standard review: check the diff against docs/Design system for AI agents/readme.md (tokens, spacing, component classes, copy casing), docs/agents/anti-patterns.md (empty today, so trivially clear), scope (does the change do only what REQ-001a asked, no more/less), and consistency with docs/agents/decisions/ (only 0001, unrelated).
acceptance_criteria: git diff master...HEAD read directly, not just the FRONTEND-DEV handoff summary
Each of the 4 reported deviations explicitly judged, not silently accepted or silently flagged without a verdict
Scope check confirms no unrelated changes bundled into this diff beyond what REQ-001a's acceptance criteria require
If a genuine violation is found, FAIL with the specific file/line and rule violated; otherwise PASS, noting any non-blocking observations for the record
